## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**

Industrials soft despite DE outperformance: HON (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -16.07%) BELOW TREND, MMM (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND.

Big 1W movers: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND; watch GOOGL (1W: +0.54% | 1M: -5.50%) RECOVERY and AMZN (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -5.04%) RECOVERY for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed/weak: AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND contrast with deep weakness in chip equipment and security names — sector 1W -1.40% (24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mildly positive but mixed: JPM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND while PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND shows idiosyncratic stress — sector 1W +0.74% (20 stocks).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive and constructive: JNJ (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, but LLY (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W +1.09% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
In a NEUTRAL regime favor balanced exposure: favor Energy and selective Healthcare/Communication names (VLO, CVX, NVS, META) and reduce exposure to weak Tech/Industrials (AMAT, PANW, HON). Monitor major-cap divergences (GOOGL/AMZN/WMT) and mixed PYPL headlines before rotating deeply.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.22%; 10 stocks) and Healthcare (1W: +1.09%; 17 stocks) for momentum.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.40%; 24 stocks) and Industrials (1W: -2.58%; 15 stocks) for downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND for hold of 1W gains as a signal to keep tech exposure; AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND — loss of the last week’s pivot would signal short-term softening; DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND — continuation above recent breakout confirms industrial recovery.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PYPL (+80): takeover chatter — PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND, sentiment diverging from price (distribution).  
NVS (+60): drug-deal headline — NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming price strength.  
DE (+50): analyst upgrade — DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming strong accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (-45): regulator scrutiny headline — TSLA (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND, news diverging from price (watch for follow-through).  
AAPL (-30): China/operational scrutiny — AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND, negative headlines but price holding (divergence).  
PYPL (-45): cost cuts/job-cut headlines — PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND, mixed sentiment — high dispersion and event risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Energy and select large caps showing strength: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: major-cap divergence (GOOGL/AMZN/WMT and FCX) and mixed PYPL news — watch for trend breaks before committing to large sector shifts.
